title: 5cd U2 short window (cc-wiki #80): AppManager loopback probe + Skia writer watchpoint attempt
board: 5cd (U2: runtime .so d932f2ba unchanged, JAR 0715c964; verified intact + released; temp binaries removed; no runtime change; appspawn-x never killed)
dispatch: ACK(80) 13:46: 5cd <=30min: (1) AppManager loopback fast-refuse probe; (2) watchpoint on whichever of AntennaPod/FitoTrack reproduces RenderThread SIGSEGV first, else record 未复现; clean DETACH, no kill-9; verify U2 fingerprint then UNLOCK.

appmanager_loopback_probe.result: REFUTES my earlier platform-diff finding. OH loopback connect() to a CLOSED port FAST-REFUSES exactly like Linux/Android.
appmanager_loopback_probe.data: loopback_probe.ohos (aarch64-linux-ohos, built with DevEco native clang-15) on 5cd: port 59999 (closed) -> ECONNREFUSED in 0.4 ms; port 5555 (adb, closed) -> ECONNREFUSED in 0.1 ms. Linux baseline (a2hlab) = 0.1 ms. All FAST-REFUSE.
appmanager_loopback_probe.correction: NEXTWALL-TRIAGE-newpipe-spd-appmanager.json section (3) claimed 'OH loopback TCP to a closed port does not fast-refuse (no RST) => Ops.connectAdb blocks'. That is WRONG: OH DOES send an immediate RST (0.1-0.4ms ECONNREFUSED). So the AppManager '正在验证' hang is NOT a loopback-refuse platform diff.
appmanager_loopback_probe.revised_direction: AppManager Ops.autoConnectWirelessDebugging most likely blocks in mDNS/NSD wireless-debug SERVICE DISCOVERY (no responder -> long/never), or an adb pairing wait, NOT a plain TCP connect-to-closed-port. Re-read the autoConnectWirelessDebugging flow (mDNS/NsdManager) if pursued. Outer ring said don't deep-dive; recorded corrected. Owner remains platform/app-behavior, not a loopback-RST fix.

watchpoint_attempt.tooling: watchpoint_helper.ohos built (aarch64-linux-ohos): PTRACE_SEIZE RenderThread -> SW breakpoint at libskia onResetContext (base+0x123d230) resolves per-run A=*(GrGLGpu+0xb0)+0x8 -> NT_ARM_HW_WATCH 8-byte write watchpoint on A -> dump writer on misaligned store.
watchpoint_attempt.feasibility_gate: SELinux = Permissive (getenforce=Permissive, /sys/fs/selinux/enforce=0) => ptrace is NOT blocked by SELinux on 5cd. The watchpoint approach is feasible in principle.
watchpoint_attempt.obstacle: OH app processes appear in the process table as 'appspawn-x --socket-name AppSpawnX' (identified by app UID, not bundle name) -> pidof <bundle> fails; must resolve by UID. More critically: within the short window, launch-only did not leave a stable, attachable, actively-rendering target, and AntennaPod's crash (when it fires, ~1/3) happens early (~2-3s after launch, post-first-frame) -> could not win the attach-before-crash race in-window. Running the full (disruptive) helper on the pre-existing unknown app pid was unsafe (would leave a BRK in a crashing process).
watchpoint_attempt.outcome: 未复现 / 未能 attach this window (per dispatch allowance). Helper + method are ready; needs a longer dedicated window with: resolve app pid by UID, attach immediately post-launch (poll /proc every ~50ms), or disable ASLR for stable A + pre-arm. SELinux-permissive means ptrace itself will work.
watchpoint_attempt.note: A full-tombstone capture (memory-near-registers) also did not land: no fresh antennapod cppcrash appeared this window (launch-only liveness capture was ambiguous; earlier 0/6 dedicated runs).

one_line_for_cx_t0: 5cd U2 window: (a) AppManager — OH loopback FAST-REFUSES closed ports (ECONNREFUSED 0.1-0.4ms, = Linux); my earlier 'no fast-refuse' platform-diff is REFUTED; the hang is NOT the connect (likely mDNS/NSD wireless-debug discovery). (b) Skia writer watchpoint — SELinux Permissive (ptrace OK), helper ready, but couldn't win attach-before-crash on the intermittent early crash in the short window; recorded 未复现, needs a longer window (attach-by-UID immediately post-launch, or ASLR-off + pre-arm).
